name: Learning Rate Scheduling
learningObjectives: Understand why learning rate scheduling improves optimization
Compare different scheduling strategies (step, exponential, cosine, etc.)
Learn when to use each type of schedule
Visualize the impact of scheduling on convergence
Understand the trade-offs between different scheduling approaches
